mentions.context: and His Chaldean Commentators Should Be Understood; hereafter Zoroastrian Con- clusions).18 In conclusions 8 > 5, 8 > 11 and 8 > 14, the Latin translations of three oracles of Zoroaster’s from M are found. Another reference to M is found in conclusion 24.31: “Secundum precedentem conclusionem ex Procli mente potest exponi unum ex dictis Zoroastris secundum quod apud Graecos legitur, quanquam apud Chaldeos aliter et legitur et exponitur”.19 In other words, according to Pico, in their original version the Chaldean oracles not only read diﬀerently but also evinced a diﬀerent meaning,
